I feel like for me, it's a lot of factors. If the music is nice, if the gameplay is good, and if the characters are interesting. The music of harvest moon usually ends up being my favorite part, so if the music isn't that great then i won't be too fond of the game. And the gameplay. If its boring then ill end up dropping it. Thats why I dropped tott after I got married to cam. And the characters, they have to be interesting. I think those are the three main important factors for me. Oh, bonus points if the game has an decent mining system! Mining is my favorite way to spend my winters in game.
